# Introduction
The {{"template":"referral","description":"an unobtainable block","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is an unobtainable block introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / yam:u1"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_base:0.0.3"}}. When mod author {{"of":"to_base:author / to_base:joshmanisdabomb"}} starts a new modding project, it is the first item implemented for testing purposes.

# History
In {{"of":"to_base:mod_version / yam:u1"}}, right clicking with this item would teleport the player to {{"of":"minecraft:dimension / yam:sheol"}}. This debug method was the only way to reach the dimension.
